query:
SELECT id, name FROM plants WHERE name IN ('Rosa damascena','Boswellia sacra','Commiphora myrrha','Cannabis sativa','Nicotiana tabacum','Nardostachys jatamansi','Cinnamomum verum','Syzygium aromaticum') LIMIT 10;
SELECT id, name FROM molecules WHERE name IN ('Cinnamaldéhyde','Muscone','Ambroxan','Linalol','Myrcène','α-Pinène','β-Caryophyllène','Géraniol','Eugénol') LIMIT 10;
